units.source_text: （现在这地步，可不能假装不知道哟……

en.t: At this point, you cannot pretend you do not know...

units.source_text: 在日本这样的条件下，多湿温带地区，水灾占每年灾害的百分之八十七，

en.t: Under conditions like Japan's, in a humid temperate region, floods account for eighty-seven percent of the disasters each year,

units.source_text: 这种流沙灾害，连小数点以下三位都没有。

en.t: while disasters from drifting sand do not even register to three decimal places.

units.source_text: 就像在撒哈拉大沙漠，搞个什么“水灾特别立法”，

en.t: It would be like passing some kind of "special flood legislation" in the Sahara Desert,

units.source_text: 难道不是脱裤子放屁，多此一举吗！）

en.t: wouldn't that be a ridiculous, completely pointless extra step!）
